# ztna_fqdn_application_list (Data Source)

Retrieves a listing of config items.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `device` (String) The device of the item.
- `filters` (String) String to filter list results by searching one specified field of an object. Multiple filters can be specified.
- `folder` (String) The folder of the item. Default: Shared.
- `limit` (Number) The max number of items to return. Default: 200.
- `name` (String) The name of the item.
- `offset` (Number) The offset of the first item to return.
- `search` (String) String to filter list results by. Is searched over multiple fields in each object. Multiple searches can be specified.
- `snippet` (String) The snippet of the item.
- `sort` (String) List of fields from item response to sort by.

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes List) The data. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `tfid` (String) The Terraform ID.
- `total` (Number) The total number of items.

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Optional:

- `name` (String) Name of the FQDN rule.

Read-Only:

- `anycast_ip` (String) Anycast IP address assigned to this FQDN rule.
- `app_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the FQDN rule is enabled.

If omitted, defaults to false.
- `created_time` (String) Created time
- `description` (String) The description of the resource
- `group` (String) A comma separated list of connector group IDs
- `icmp_allowed` (Boolean) Whether ICMP is allowed for this FQDN rule.

If omitted, defaults to true.
- `oid` (String) The UUID of the resource
- `spec` (Attributes List) Spec (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--spec))
- `tfid` (String) The Terraform ID.
- `updated_time` (String) Updated time
- `use_dc_ip` (Boolean) Whether to use datacenter IP for this FQDN rule.

If omitted, defaults to false.

<a id="nestedatt--data--spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.spec`

Read-Only:

- `fqdn` (String) FQDN of the rule.
- `probe_port` (String) The probing port if the `probe_type` is `tcp_ping`.
- `probe_type` (String) The probing type.

The value can be `tcp_ping`, `icmp_ping`, or omitted.
- `tcp_port` (String) TCP port number(s).

It can be a single port number, multiple port numbers separated by comma,
or a port range like 8000-9000.

If both tcp_port and udp_port are omitted, tcp_port defaults to 443.
- `udp_port` (String) UDP port number(s).

It can be a single port number, multiple port numbers separated by comma,
or a port range like 8000-9000.

If both tcp_port and udp_port are omitted, tcp_port defaults to 443.
